blocks.label: Horizon 1 — Equal Info
blocks.instructions:
Region Monitoring — Short HorizonEach round, the system automatically gathers 4 contacts from East and West regions (2 from each). You see the payoff for each gathered contact.
  • After gathering, you make 1 choice: monitor East or West. You earn the payoff from whichever region has more activity.
  • One region always has higher average payoff than the other.

blocks.label: Horizon 6 — Equal Info
blocks.instructions:
Region Monitoring — Long HorizonThe system gathers 4 contacts (2 East, 2 West). You then make 6 choices in sequence, each scored immediately.
  • With 6 choices ahead, it may pay to explore the region you know less about before committing.

blocks.label: Horizon 1 — Unequal Info
blocks.instructions:
Region Monitoring — Short Horizon, Unequal GatheringThe system gathers 4 contacts but splits them unevenly: 1 from one region, 3 from the other.
  • You make 1 choice. You know more about the region sampled 3 times — use that knowledge.

blocks.label: Horizon 6 — Unequal Info
blocks.instructions:
Region Monitoring — Long Horizon, Unequal GatheringThe system gathers 4 contacts unevenly (1 from one region, 3 from the other). You then make 6 choices.
  • With more choices ahead, exploring the undersampled region first gives you better information for subsequent choices.
